After nearly two decades of unforgettable moments with Argentina, the captain is set to retire from international football, closing the book on one of the greatest careers the sport has ever seen.

From the heartbreak of losing Copa América and World Cup finals to finally lifting the Copa América and World Cup, Messi’s story with Argentina became a journey of perseverance, redemption and greatness.

He gave Argentina everything. The goals, the assists, the trophies, the magic, and countless memories that will never be forgotten.

The boy from Rosario grew into Argentina’s greatest ever footballer, and now, the final chapter with the national team is approaching.

The end of an era is here. Lionel Messi’s international career is coming to a close.
